en.headline: Hiker finds wartime bullet on Black’s Link; police seize it for testing
en.dek: A walker discovered a single round while on the Hong Kong Island trail on Sunday, took it home to Happy Valley and called police; officers classified the case as ammunition found and sent the item for laboratory examination.
body: A hiker who found a single bullet on Black’s Link on Hong Kong Island took the round home to Green Lane in Happy Valley before calling police on Sunday afternoon. Officers responded, seized the cartridge for testing and classified the case as an ammunition find.

Police received the report at 3.47pm. The finder said the discovery was made while walking the trail and that the item was then carried to a Green Lane address where help was sought. Officers conducted a preliminary check at the flat, took possession of the bullet and sent it for laboratory examination rather than leaving it with the caller.

The file was logged as “ammunition found” and handed to Wan Chai District Crime Investigation Team 8. According to information available after the call-out, the seized round is a wartime bullet. No calibre, maker’s mark or assessment of whether it remained live was released with the Sunday statement from the force. No one was injured and no evacuation was required.

zh.headline: 布力徑行山客發現戰時子彈 警方檢走化驗
zh.dek: 行山人士周日在港島布力徑發現一枚子彈，帶回跑馬地箕璉坊住所後報警；警員接報檢取子彈作化驗，案件列彈藥發現。
body: 一名行山客周日在港島布力徑行山時發現一枚子彈，其後將子彈帶回跑馬地箕璉坊住所，再於下午約3時47分報警求助。警員接報到場，經初步調查將該枚子彈檢取並帶走作化驗，案件列「彈藥發現」。
據了解，涉事子彈為戰時子彈。案件交由灣仔警區刑事調查隊第八隊跟進。警方表示事件中無人受傷，亦毋須疏散。
警方並未公開子彈口徑、製造商標記，或是否仍然有殺傷力的評估。類似戰時彈藥在港島及離島行山徑偶有發現，市民如遇上應即時報警，切勿自行處理。
